allowed.claim: Structural correctness, target representability, gradient validity, optimizer-level trainability, and successful solver training are distinct qualification layers.
Hard reciprocal antisymmetry can preserve linear-momentum-compatible correction structure through dynamic RK2 training.
A raw next-state loss can provide poorly detectable training gradients even when the neural correction Jacobian is nonzero.
A D0-centered scale-aware conservative discrete-defect target can restore identifiable optimizer-level training signals.
Verified local descent and actual optimizer-update dynamics do not guarantee achievement of a frozen global training criterion.
Increasing formula heterogeneity alone does not guarantee coverage of the discrete correction-target manifold.
Formula/physics descriptor coverage does not imply raw correction-target manifold coverage.
A prospectively systematic coverage design can improve descriptor-space support while still fail target-space coverage.
The project did not establish a qualified trained SPH–Transformer solver.
